name: webkitgtk
description: The WebKitGTK package is a port of the portable web rendering engine WebKit to the GTK-3 and GTK-4 platforms. BLFS: some compile jobs need >4 GiB RAM each; this port limits ninja parallelism to MemAvailable/4 GiB to avoid OOM freezes.

user: WEBKIT_JOBS=${WEBKIT_JOBS:-$(awk '/MemAvailable:/ {j=int($2/4194304)} END { if (j<1) print 1; else print j }' /proc/meminfo)}; echo "webkitgtk: limiting ninja to -j${WEBKIT_JOBS} (~4 GiB RAM per job; export WEBKIT_JOBS to override)"; echo "${WEBKIT_JOBS}" > .webkit-jobs

cmake -B build-gtk3 -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release     \
      -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr    \
      -D CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RPATH=ON  \
      -D PORT=GTK                     \
      -D LIB_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/lib     \
      -D USE_LIBBACKTRACE=OFF         \
      -D USE_LIBHYPHEN=OFF            \
      -D ENABLE_GAMEPAD=OFF           \
      -D ENABLE_MINIBROWSER=OFF       \
      -D ENABLE_DOCUMENTATION=OFF     \
      -D ENABLE_WEBDRIVER=OFF         \
      -D USE_WOFF2=OFF                \
      -D USE_GTK4=OFF                 \
      -D ENABLE_BUBBLEWRAP_SANDBOX=ON \
      -D USE_SYSPROF_CAPTURE=NO       \
      -D ENABLE_SPEECH_SYNTHESIS=OFF  \
      -W no-dev -G Ninja .

cmake -B build-gtk4 -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release         \
      -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr        \
      -D CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RPATH=ON      \
      -D PORT=GTK                         \
      -D LIB_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/lib         \
      -D USE_LIBBACKTRACE=OFF             \
      -D USE_LIBHYPHEN=OFF                \
      -D ENABLE_GAMEPAD=OFF               \
      -D ENABLE_MINIBROWSER=OFF           \
      -D ENABLE_DOCUMENTATION=OFF         \
      -D USE_WOFF2=OFF                    \
      -D USE_GTK4=ON                      \
      -D ENABLE_BUBBLEWRAP_SANDBOX=ON     \
      -D USE_SYSPROF_CAPTURE=NO           \
      -D ENABLE_SPEECH_SYNTHESIS=OFF      \
      -W no-dev -G Ninja .
